data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit name 'Jahnvi', meaning 'Goddess Ganga'. The Goddess Ganga is revered as the embodiment of purity, grace, and power in Hindu theology. The name Jahnviya reflects the admiration and reverence towards the Goddess, and it can be considered as a tribute to the Hindu cultural heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jahnviya imbibes a deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the name of the Goddess Ganga. The Hindu scriptures, particularly the Mahabharata, describe the Goddess Ganga as the life-giving force, the source of all knowledge, and the inspiration for spiritual growth. The name Jahnviya can serve as a reminder to seek the blessings of the Goddess for purity, knowledge, and spiritual growth in one's life. Additionally, it can be a constant source of inspiration to remain connected to the divine and live a virtuous life.
